descriptions.zh: 我们的能量赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
descriptions.en: Our energy deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.
